newAtoms.contract: Project sum(initial-current Supply) across all friendly army units, including reserves and destroyed units; evaluate cumulative thresholds without conflating mission Supply or kill credit.
Choose another visible friendly Biological unit and resolve its actual 2 Damage before the promised Run/HITS/BUFF continuation; retain paid-cost lineage.
Interrupt pending incoming Damage, resolve damage to a different friendly recipient, then reduce the original batch by the normal or empowered amount before allocation.
Before movement commits, test leading path and all final model positions against a Fire Wall; remove the token, resolve HITS, suppress charge IMPACT, then resume or terminate the same movement.
Player selects permitted individual models to replace numeric weapon attacks with FT coverage, including the melee variant; do not duplicate those models in numeric pools.
Retain the pending casualty batch and its pre-removal geometry; optional paid reaction deals HITS per model about to die, then removes those models exactly once.
Reject another summon while any living summoned child of this parent exists, independent of child type and of other parents.
Grant a round-scoped permission to reuse an already-used summon without erasing the original once-per-game record or granting other summon types.
After summon, or a parent ability targeting its own child, let the controller perform the specified child movement and return to the suspended parent ownership.
Store a marker while the parent is in reserves; at round end offer optional base-contact deployment with current legality, then consume the once-game scheduled effect.

On enemy activation end or successful charge, resolve a mandatory melee attack against the qualifying enemy, including defence/casualty choices, then remove the source and restore the parent continuation.
Before each PLACE, optionally choose an enemy; constrain that placement directly towards it and bind the RoA bonus exclusively to attacks against that target.
Consume the enemy INFESTATION after marking that enemy activated; optionally select a nearby non-Unique friendly Infested unit and remove its activation marker, preserving phase ownership.
For an infected enemy, block its own enemy reactions and enemy reactions targeting it, while retaining the explicit Restoration exception and controller-relative allegiance.
For an infected enemy, reject PLACE, set effects and return-to-reserves across all movement/lifecycle entry points; ordinary legal movement remains available.
Permit Terran Ground Mechanical purchases only under the Stukov faction while applying costs, slots, uniqueness and upgrade rules to the original source identity.
Bind the imported units to Infested tag addition, CP-to-BM payment conversion and BURROWED prohibition without changing unrelated units or rewriting the source records.
When the faction sets its structure, suppress its abilities except Structure for that round, then restore the correct abilities after cleanup; do not silently grant SUMMON semantics.
Use remaining shield points to derive attack/IMPACT dice or detonation damage with each printed rounding rule. Withdrawn Archon source only.
Reduce a friendly pending damage batch by spending this source shield reservoir with the exact optional/fixed amount and shielded requirements. Conflicting withdrawn Archon drafts.
Once per round, waive exhaustion of a non-Faction card targeting the carrier, without readying an already exhausted card or changing other payment requirements. Withdrawn Archon source only.
